traits.name: Blue-Ringed Octopus Venom
traits.text: (poison); Saving Throw DC 17 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 1d4 (1d4) poison damage (1 round) Stage 2 1d6 (1d6) poison damage (1 round) Stage 3 1d6 (1d6) poison damage and paralyzed (1 round)

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.text: The blue-ringed octopus can change the color of its skin to Hide even if it doesn't have cover.

traits.name: Jet
traits.text: ⬺ The blue-ringed octopus moves up to 60 feet in a straight line through the water without triggering reactions.

traits.name: Toxic Bite
traits.text: ⬻ Requirements The blue-ringed octopus has a creature grabbed Effect The blue-ringed octopus makes a beak Strike against the grabbed creature. If it hits, it injects additional poison, causing its venom to gain the virulent trait.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ beak +7 (finesse); Damage 1d6 (1d6) piercing plus blue-ringed octopus venom
